description:
The Greedy Frog Who Wanted All The Flies: Being Satisfied! — Barnaby the bullfrog had already eaten 20 juicy flies, but tried to swallow 50 more in one giant gulp! What happened to his swollen tummy?
Kids science answer for "contentment and greed moral story for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Wanting more and more without appreciating what you already have leads to discomfort; true contentment brings peace and full bellies.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
